records.title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
records.reason: Adaptive execution memory for robot VLA control; the contribution is task control and test-time adaptation, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: ScentGen: Hierarchical Multimodal Olfactory Semantic Modeling for Molecular Odor Description Generation
records.reason: Olfactory semantic modeling for molecular odor description; outside LLM inference/serving scope.

records.title: Delayed Supervision for Test-Time Language Models
records.reason: Delayed supervision trains test-time language-model memory to answer later questions from accumulated streams. The body reports comparisons against original/event-next-token-prediction baselines, but explicitly says it does not isolate delay's causal effect and makes no universal superiority claim; no inference-latency/throughput gain is established, so relevance to runtime-efficiency literature is weak.

records.title: MergeHEIR: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations as the Tax of Model Merging
records.reason: Model-merging study targets multimodal hallucination quality; no direct inference resource improvement is established.

records.title: CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments
records.reason: Urban 3D visual QA benchmark and tool use; no inference efficiency method.
